LESSON: LIGHT

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Healthy Environment
Topic 2.3: Light
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Light, part of Healthy Environment in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we conserve light energy in our environment? 2.Why should we conserve light energy in our environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Light together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: Writing skills as the learner makes posters with simple messages on conservation of light to

create awareness.

Values:
 Responsibility: Hard work skills as learners make posters with simple messages on conservation of light.

 Unity:: Cooperation skills as learners manipulate objects to form shadows in the presence of light for enjoyment in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social economic issues: Financial skills as learners make posters with simple messages on conservation of light to create

awareness.

Link to other Learning Areas:

English Llanguage Activities: Writing skills as learners make posters on energy conservation.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Approved learning support materials, Candles, Torch, theme based Pictures/ Photographs/ Newspaper cuttings/ Flash cards/
